# owner: platform
import unittest

from tests.support import data_file
from rosterkit.reader import read_roster
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_sheet

class ContactSheetTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        students = read_roster(data_file("roster.csv"))
        self.emailed = [
            item for item in students if item.email
        ]

    def test_rows_are_sorted_by_name(self):
        backwards = self.emailed[::-1]
        rows = contact_sheet(backwards).splitlines()
        names = [row[:24].strip() for row in rows]
        expected = [
            "Dunmere, Piet",
            "Halloway, Juno",
            "Thistle, Bram",
            "Varrow, Ines"
        ]
        self.assertEqual(names, expected)

    def test_columns_line_up(self):
        rows = contact_sheet(self.emailed).splitlines()
        self.assertEqual(rows[0][25:26], "B")
        email = rows[0][34:]
        self.assertEqual(email, "pdunmere@example.edu")

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        students = read_roster(data_file("roster.csv"))
        message = "Quillon, Sefa"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, message):
            contact_sheet(students)

    def test_empty_list_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_sheet([])
